lines: How to re-buffer — step by step
3 × 1000 L tanks of water · 3 kg Calcinit total (1 kg per tank) · a cup for the edge pour.
soak/drench with calcium nitrate (~1 kg Calcinit / 1000 L), then drain.
This stops the coir stealing calcium and flushes sodium.
Blend in ~20–30% fresh coir or perlite to keep it airy; discard coir from any diseased crop.
Fill polybags with drainage holes; stand them on lifters ~1 inch off the floor; one 2 L/hr dripper
Un-buffered coir + your humidity = blossom-end rot from day one.
Put the polybags back in the greenhouse
— each bag in its correct row and number (A01,
A02 … J43), on lifters ~1 inch off the floor.
Put one dripper in each bag
— push it into the top of the cocopeat; check it is not blocked.
run the drippers until the tank is empty. Check water drips out the bottom of the bags —
and check the bags at the
. If they aren't wet, tell the supervisor.
— this is when the calcium sticks to the cocopeat. Don't skip it.
